The test image shows coffee leaves with multiple circular, dark brown spots on the upper surface. The spots are roughly 5-10mm, solid dark brown/reddish-brown. Some lighter/grey-white patches visible on the right leaf. No obvious yellow halo or powdery coating visible.

Key candidates: Brown_Eye_Spot (circular spots with grey center, dark ring, yellow halo), Cerscospora (similar circular spots), Phoma (dark circular spots).

Now I'll view one reference per class to compare.
Berry_Blotch PlantWild_79 shows a spot with grey center, dark ring, and yellow halo - similar to what I see in the test image. Let me view one more reference to compare Brown_Eye_Spot directly.

**Analysis summary:**

- **Test image**: Multiple circular dark brown spots (~5-10mm) on green coffee leaves in natural field setting. Some spots have slight concentric patterning; right leaf shows grey-white patches.
- **Berry_Blotch (PlantWild_107)**: Very similar - multiple circular dark spots on green leaves in natural field setting, same density and distribution.
- **Berry_Blotch (PlantWild_79)**: Shows grey center, dark ring, yellow halo - matches the spot structure in test image.
- **Brown_Eye_Spot (PlantWild_13)**: Similar circular spot with yellow halo, but isolated and more pronounced yellow ring.
- **Brown_Eye_Spot (PlantWild_3)**: Shows smaller, less distinct spots with more severe leaf yellowing/necrosis - less similar to test.
- **Phoma**: Large irregular dark necrotic patches - very different.
- **Rust**: Orange-yellow powdery underside lesions - very different.
- **Miner**: Irregular brown patches from larval mining - very different.

The test image most closely matches Berry_Blotch (PlantWild_107) - same natural field context, multiple circular solid dark brown spots on healthy green leaves. The grey-white patches visible on the right leaf align with "light brown or grey centres" described for Berry_Blotch.
